items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: He told me he was going to buy a book if I wanted one of them, that trumpet, and I had to study, and study hard.

ctx.x: They were trained musicians, or did they strictly run by head?

Oh no, they were strictly musicians. Yeah. And I used to tell them that I wanted to play something, see, but I hadn't made up my mind. But my daddy told me if I wanted to play, you know, following his footsteps, the trombone, I liked my uncle the trumpet, that he didn't want no ear playing, he was strictly against that, because they was musicians. He told me he was going to buy a book if I wanted one of them, that trumpet, and I had to study, and study hard. And he wanted me to study first. He wouldn't give me no…
How old were you when you first got the drums? Eight years.
